sections.description: Mimam's Var - WP is a modular design-system operating layer inside WordPress. Centralize your CSS variables, manage theme scales, configure fluid scales, build layout utility structures, and sync seamlessly with Figma.
sections.changelog:
v1.3.119 - Dev

  • Resolved Infinite Vue Reactivity Loop: Introduced deep equality comparisons (isDeepEqual) on settings assignments inside the Bricks adapter to block cyclic updates and prevent Out of Memory canvas crashes during bulk command executions.

v1.3.118 - Dev

  • Fixed Cross-Realm Vue Proxy Feedback Loop: Resolved memory leak/crash (out of memory) and element rendering corruption when synchronizing setting updates with the canvas iframe. In same-origin frames, Vue 3 proxies wrapping top-window settings objects inside the iframe caused cross-realm reactivity cycles and infinite loops. We now serialize the settings object using JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(nextSettings)) inside the iframe window's JSON context before assignment, stripping all Vue proxy wrappers and top-window prototypes. This ensures 100% clean, native iframe settings assignments that integrate perfectly with the canvas's local Vue app.

v1.3.117 - Dev

  • Implemented Direct Canvas Iframe settings and rerenderElementIds Synchronization: Direct same-origin Vue state synchronization for bulk operations. Previously, when mutating element settings on non-selected elements inside the top window, the canvas in the iframe did not update. This is because Bricks' native message postMessage watcher explicitly excludes the 'components' key from synchronization, and the 'rerenderElementIds' array is also excluded. We now locate the same element inside the iframe's Vue elements list directly and overwrite its settings, and push the element's ID directly to the iframe's Vue state 'rerenderElementIds' array.
  • Added Detailed Console Logging for Bulk Operations: Integrated info and warning console logs to trace bulk matching checks (matchesBulkTarget), element counts, resolved tags, direct settings overrides, and re-renders.
